mechanisms.evidence_quote:
Changes in cement process production, in this case the clinker index reduction program has an impact on 
electrical energy performance.
A decrease in mill capacity with the same baseload causes the intensity of electrical energy consumption to increase.

Does not account for baseload and 
non-linear effects

influential variables so that the use of multiple regression for new baselines will be considered.

study_limitations.evidence_quote:
Currently PT Semen Tonasa focuses on 7 SEUs (Plant 4/5 and Power Plant 
CD), and the next few years will be implemented on other SEUs that have the potential for energy efficiency.

implementation_barriers.barrier: Energy team had to balance implementing ISO 50001 with their other primary duties; energy management tasks are functional and not in structural job descriptions
implementation_barriers.evidence_quote:
One of the main challenges faced during the Semen Tonasa implementation was the balancing act the energy 
team had to play between implementing ISO 50001 and their other primary duties/roles.

implementation_barriers.barrier: Need to increase competence of human resources / energy teams through training to support energy management
implementation_barriers.evidence_quote:
Increasing the competence of human resources / energy teams through training is very necessary to support 
the implementation of energy management.

implementation_barriers.barrier: Need to build an IT system and central database so energy performance can be monitored online and records documented
implementation_barriers.evidence_quote:
It is important to build an IT system and central data base so that energy performance can be monitored online 
and all records are well documented.

reviewer_notes: Paper is an ISO 50001 implementation case study for PT Semen Tonasa cement plant. Table 1 gives five single-regression thermal baselines (M1-M5), extracted individually. The paper also states electrical baselines were built by single regression (M6) but gives no equation, coefficients or R square; M6 is inferred from the text and most fields are not reported. Overall energy efficiency results (6.4% in 2018, 8.7% in semester 1-2019, cost saving 127.603.336.352 IDR, ~250,351 tCO2 avoided) are aggregate across all SEUs and cannot be cleanly attributed to a single model; recorded once on M1 as requires inference with a note. The clinker-factor reduction mechanism (K1/K2) is tied to the electrical baseline (M6).
